title: health/iosxe/YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM-SSZ.json
description: IOS-XE lab slip (Kind observation). Written on the first visit, when something material moved against health/metadata-iosxe.json current[], or when coverage is not complete. metrics are per-device counts. readings are only the rows that moved or are abnormal this visit; the first visit writes every row and becomes baseline_ref. A reading is a board row (device, interface, or bgp) plus an optional note. unchanged counts the board rows not in readings. vs_prior.changed is structured: one item per field that moved. No RESTCONF body. No topology: physical neighbors live on inventory/topology-observed.json.

headline.description: Quotes measurements: which subject, which field, prior -> current, since when; then the unchanged count.

scope.description: "all" when every ranked device was collected; else the device keys the task line named.

concerns.description: One device entity-ref when that device rebooted since the board, has cpu_5m >= 80 or mem_used_pct >= 85, has unsaved_config true, or has a non-zero oper_not_ready / bgp_not_established / increased errors or flaps. Omit healthy devices.

metrics.description: One row per collected device, scope device:<name>.

readings.description: First visit: every board row. Later visits: only rows with a changed[] item this visit, plus rows abnormal now (device rebooted or over a cpu/memory threshold, interface admin-up and oper not ready, BGP not established). Not the whole estate.

unchanged.description: Count of board rows not in readings. 0 on the first visit. null when coverage is unavailable.

baseline_ref.description: health/iosxe/<baseline_visit_id>.json — the first-visit stamp that listed every subject. Null on the first visit itself.

entity_ref.description: workspace-handoff entity reference. Do not copy the referenced object. Do not invent id.

vs_prior.description: Diff of this collection against metadata current[]. First visit: prior_watch_id null, delta first, changed []. Later visits: one changed item per material field that moved.

prior_watch_id.description: metadata last_visit_id at the start of this visit.

delta.description: worse when any change lowered health (a reboot, state left ready/established, errors or flaps increased, cpu/memory crossed a threshold upward, a peer disappeared). better when every change raised it. changed when neither (new row, software_version changed, ACL bound).

prior.description: Prior value from the board; null when the row is new (field row).

current.description: Value this visit; null when the row disappeared (field row).

at.description: The interface's last-change when the field is state on an interface row; the new boot-time when the field is boot_time; otherwise this visit's checked_at.

oper_not_ready.description: Board interfaces admin-up and oper not ready.

in_errors.description: Sum of in_errors + in_crc_errors over board interfaces.

cpu_5m_max.description: Highest cpu_5m among collected devices (the device's own value on a device row).

reading.description: A board row (health-metadata-iosxe row, identical field names) plus an optional note.

name.description: Device name as inventory/prod.json writes it.

subject.description: device: the device name again. interface: name as the device returns it. bgp: neighbor id.

keys.description: device:<name>; plus interface:<name>/<subject> on interface rows; plus the peer device key on a resolved bgp row.

state.description: device: up (it answered). interface: oper-status as returned. bgp: state as returned.

last_changed.description: device: boot-time (moves only on reboot). interface: the device's last-change. bgp: checked_at of the visit that last saw a material field move (or first saw the row).

software_version.description: device: the token after 'Version ' in software-version, e.g. 17.15.1a.

reason_severity.description: device: normal or abnormal, as returned.

mem_used_pct.description: device: round(used-memory / total-memory * 100) for the Processor pool.

unsaved_config.description: device: as returned. Not material; a concern when true.

in_discards.description: interface: last seen. Recorded and summed on the metric; an increase alone is not material.

input_acl.description: interface: input-security-acl name, null when absent or empty string.

up_time.description: bgp: as returned. Shorter than the board's value means the session reset.

peer.description: bgp: device:<name> when the neighbor id equals an interface address of a device in inventory/prod.json (from this visit's interface payloads or inventory/topology-observed.json); else null.

note.description: Required when the row changed this visit or is abnormal. Omit on a healthy unchanged row. The note is the nurse's opinion: what moved, since when, and what the ACL, peer, and far-end columns say about the cause. Do not repeat column values or addresses.
